title: GTCEu Indicators for Nomifactory CeU
description: Adds several indicators to help identify circuits, boards, wafers, chips etc. Including Nomifactory CeU specific items.
body:
# TLDR
A modification of [GTCEuM Indicators](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/gtceum-indicators) resourcepack with additional indicators for universal circuits.

# Credits

- [Usernm0](https://github.com/Usernm0/) for making the original indicators
- [fullsets](https://modrinth.com/user/fullsets) for putting together the original GTCEuM Indicators pack.
